Title: Hydra legacy target blacklist permits unsafe PyYAML loading
Description:
Hydra's legacy target blacklist omits PyYAML's unsafe loading surfaces. If an
application passes attacker-controlled targets and arguments to instantiate(),
a target such as yaml.unsafe_load can execute Python code through a
config-controlled YAML stream containing Python object-construction tags.
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 1.3.6 before 1.3.8, all versions starting from 1.4.0-dev.9 before 1.4.0-rc.3
NotImpacted: All versions before 1.3.6, all versions starting from 1.3.8 before 1.4.0-dev.9, all versions starting from 1.4.0-rc.3
